blocks.text: Covalent bond do atoms ke darmiyan electrons ki bahami shirakat (mutual sharing) se banta hai. Electrons baantte hue har atom apna valence shell mukammal karta hai aur qareeb tareen noble gas configuration pata hai. Covalent bond non-polar ya polar ho sakta hai. Do chlorine atoms ke darmiyan bond khalis covalent aur non-polar hai: dono atoms ki electronegativity bilkul ek jaisi hai, to bandhe hue atoms barqi taur par ghair-janibdar rehte hain aur kisi atom par charge nahi. Aise doosre molecules H2, F2, Br2 aur I2 hain. Polar covalent bonds ki misalein H-Cl, H-Br aur H2O ke bonds hain.

blocks.caption: Non-polar aur polar covalent bonds
rows: Ek jaisi electronegativity, kisi atom par charge nahi

blocks.prompt: Br2 ka bond non-polar aur H-Br ka polar kyun hai, halanke dono covalent hain?
blocks.explanation: Br2 mein dono atoms ek jaise hain aur un ki electronegativity barabar hai, to baanta hua jora beech mein rehta hai aur kisi atom par charge nahi. H-Br mein bromine atom hydrogen se zyada electronegative hai, baante hue jore ko apni taraf khinchta hai, aur bond par juzvi charges aa jate hain, jo use polar banate hain.

items: Covalent bond: electrons ki bahami shirakat taake har atom noble gas configuration paye; atoms ki electronegativity barabar ho to non-polar (Cl2, H2, F2, Br2, I2), mukhtalif ho to polar (H-Cl, H-Br, H2O).
